listing.name: Combat Transports
listing.summary: Adds five transport ship variations for early-to-mid game campaigns.
listing.aiSummary: Adds five transport ship variations for early-to-mid game campaigns.

description:
Combat Transports

5 Transport variations for early-mid-game campaign-layer enjoyers who would rather spread out the loggy work among their main fleet rather than go the "XL ships" route -- and because I still think spriters' work deserves to get seen in-game as much as possible for the "I love ships give me all the sips" crowd.

Ver 1.0 stable.

Ships:

Spoiler
Lion's Guard

Unarmed Eagle variant with Advanced Ground Support Package. Why? Because the Lion of Sindria demands it, of course.

Low-Tech Transport

Nomad, when you have logistics Hammerhead at home.

Valkyrie MkII

Because the Buffalo wasn't a big enough glass cannon.

Converted Liners

NebulaMkII Carrier-Transport and Starliner MkII, with superstructure heavily-retrofitted for combat.

Download here:

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1KHfoHV2im72mx_Ve-xjOtozTIy2fWnZJ?usp=sharing

aiDescription: Adds five transport ship variations designed for early-to-mid game campaigns. These ships allow players to spread logistical tasks among their main fleet instead of relying on extra-large ships. The pack includes an unarmed Eagle variant, a Nomad transport, a Valkyrie MkII, and retrofitted Nebula MkII and Starliner MkII carriers.
